scripts.build-serve-lf-documentation-js: npm run build-lf-documentation-js && npm run preserve-port-4201 && http-server ./projects/lf-documentation-js -p 4201 -o index.html
scripts.build: npm run build-ui-components-prod && npm run build-lf-documentation-prod && npm run build-lf-cdn-prod && npm run sass-lf && npm run sass-ms
scripts.build-lf-documentation-dev: npm run sass-lf && npm run sass-ms && ng build lf-documentation --configuration development --delete-output-path false
scripts.build-lf-documentation-dev-watch: npm run sass-lf && npm run sass-ms && ng build lf-documentation --configuration development --delete-output-path false --watch
scripts.build-lf-documentation-prod: npm run sass-lf && npm run sass-ms && ng build lf-documentation --configuration production --output-hashing=none
scripts.build-lf-documentation-js: npm run sass-lf && npm run create-lf-cdn && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='projects/lf-documentation-js/dist/';fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('dist/lf-cdn/browser/lf-ui-components.js',p+'lf-ui-components.js');fs.copyFileSync('dist/generated-assets/lf-laserfiche-lite.css',p+'lf-laserfiche-lite.css');fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/@angular/material/prebuilt-themes/indigo-pink.css',p+'indigo-pink.css')"
scripts.create-lf-cdn: npm run build-lf-cdn-prod && npm run rename-lf-cdn
scripts.build-enum-types: tsc projects/ui-components/shared/enums.ts --outDir types-lf-ui-components-publish --module es2022 --target es2022 --declaration false --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('types-lf-ui-components-publish/enums.js','types-lf-ui-components-publish/index.js')"
scripts.create-types-lf-ui-components: npm run tsc-cdn && npm run api-extractor && gulp processTypesFile && npm run build-enum-types && cd ./types-lf-ui-components-publish && npm pack
